harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured NFS share of /srv/nfs/shared on node1, mounted at /mnt/shared on node2, with shared dataops identity (UID/GID 4500) on both nodes and dataops:dataops 2770 permissions. Verified bidirectional file creation preserves consistent ownership, then restarted both nodes one at a time (node1 server first, node2 client second), confirming boot identity changes and full recovery of the NFS export, mount, and data on each.
actions_performed: Created dataops user/group (UID/GID 4500) on node1 and node2
Installed nfs-kernel-server on node1 and nfs-common on node2
Created /srv/nfs/shared on node1, set owner dataops:dataops, mode 2770
Configured /etc/exports on node1 restricting export to node2's IP with rw,sync,no_subtree_check; ran exportfs -ra
Enabled and started nfs-kernel-server on node1; verified listeners on ports 2049/111
Created /mnt/shared on node2, added persistent /etc/fstab entry, mounted via mount -a
Verified consistent dataops:dataops 2770 ownership/permissions on both sides and bidirectional file creation as the dataops user
Captured healthy baseline (boot_id, service state, exports, mount, file listing) on both nodes
Restarted node1 (NFS server) first; polled until reachable; confirmed changed boot_id and recovered nfs-kernel-server, exports, and data; confirmed node2's mount auto-recovered without intervention
Restarted node2 (NFS client) second; polled until reachable; confirmed changed boot_id, fstab auto-mount recovery, and successful file creation with correct ownership
Re-verified node1's export/service health after node2's restart

evidence.requirement: dataops identity UID/GID 4500 consistent on both nodes
evidence.summary: id dataops shows uid=4500(dataops) gid=4500(dataops) groups=4500(dataops) on both node1 and node2

evidence.requirement: shared directory owned dataops:dataops mode 2770
evidence.summary: ls -la and stat show /srv/nfs/shared as drwxrws--- dataops dataops (2770) on node1

evidence.requirement: NFS export configured and served on node1
evidence.summary: /etc/exports entry for /srv/nfs/shared restricted to node2 IP; exportfs -v confirms active export; nfs-kernel-server active and listening on 2049/111

evidence.requirement: NFS mount established at /mnt/shared on node2
evidence.summary: showmount -e from node2 lists the export; mount -a mounts it as nfs4 with matching source/target, added to /etc/fstab for persistence

evidence.requirement: consistent ownership/permissions and bidirectional access via shared identity
evidence.summary: Directory shows 2770 dataops:dataops on node2; file created as dataops user on node2 (from-node2.txt) and visible with correct ownership from node1, which then created from-node1.txt visible back on node2

evidence.requirement: node1 healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 4d70780a..., active nfs-kernel-server, and export list prior to restart

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Reboot scheduled and acknowledged; node became unreachable (connection timed out) confirming disruption; boot_id changed to b5e82327... on reconnect

evidence.requirement: node1 recovered service, export, and data after restart
evidence.summary: nfs-kernel-server active, export list restored, ports 2049/111 listening again, and all prior files (from-node1.txt, from-node2.txt) intact

evidence.requirement: node2 mount survived server restart without manual intervention
evidence.summary: After node1 reboot, node2's NFS mount still shown active via mount, and files listed correctly as dataops:dataops

evidence.requirement: node2 healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 37344ae4..., active mount, and dataops-owned file listing prior to restart

evidence.requirement: node2 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Reboot scheduled and acknowledged; node became unreachable confirming disruption; boot_id changed to 1d4d592d... on reconnect

evidence.requirement: node2 recovered mount, data, and read/write capability after restart
evidence.summary: fstab-based auto-mount restored /mnt/shared post-reboot; prior files intact; new file post-reboot-check.txt created successfully with dataops:dataops ownership

evidence.requirement: cluster-wide health confirmed after both restarts
evidence.summary: node1's nfs-kernel-server still active and export directory listing consistent after node2's restart, confirming no regression
